patterns.note: Modular grid layouts for content cards, often arranged in horizontal carousels or multi-column grids within full-width sections.
Consistent use of the IBM Plex Sans typeface across all text elements, maintaining a strong brand identity with clear hierarchy.
A high-contrast palette dominated by white, dark gray, and a distinctive IBM blue for interactive elements and accents.

A persistent sticky header and a floating circular call-to-action button remain visible during scroll, while content sections scroll vertically. Horizontal carousels are used for browsing related content.
Content is organized into distinct, full-width sections with clear, prominent headings, often featuring card-based information displays.

technique_notes: A fixed header and a floating circular call-to-action button are implemented to maintain navigation and key interaction points always in view during scroll.
Horizontal content carousels, likely using a library like Swiper, allow users to browse through multiple related items within a compact space, indicated by navigation arrows or pagination dots.
The overall page structure relies on vertical scrolling to reveal new content sections, with a clean transition between them without complex scroll-triggered animations.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (up to ~3x body) provide clear hierarchy, complemented by readable sans-serif body text and smaller, lighter labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and card corners, maintaining a clean, modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and organized, with generous vertical padding between sections and consistent internal spacing within card grids.

standout: The site's distinctive use of the IBM Plex typeface family and the iconic IBM blue creates a strong, recognizable brand presence. The combination of dense, modular content grids with interactive horizontal carousels allows for efficient information display without feeling cluttered, while the persistent floating CTA button offers a unique interaction point.
